description: Fork of exp603 (LUT-LM SoTA 1.4295 @ 289.4M). SINGLE change: effective batch size 16 -> 96 via grad_accum=6. device_batch_size=16 (phys; same memory as exp603), total_batch_size=49152 (was 8192). Per project_grad_accum_reproduces_big_batch (exp367), grad_accum reproduces native big-batch within ±2 mb. bs scaling was the dominant lever at tiny scale (exp349 bs=48 = -0.113, exp363 bs=128 = -0.21 vs bs=16 ref). At exp603 scale this might give a smaller gain. n_steps unchanged at 8000 (so 6x more tokens consumed, 6x more wall-clock; ~7.3h vs exp603's 1.22h). Tests whether the LUT-LM-loves-big-batches story (exp267 at 300M scale, +0.03 bpb improvement bs=8->32) transfers to exp603's architecture and scale.
